name: Open Food Facts
tagline: Open product database API for food barcodes, ingredients, nutrition, and labels worldwide
description: Open Food Facts is a free, collaborative database of food products from around the world. Its public API lets developers look up products by barcode, search by name or brand, and retrieve ingredients, nutrition facts, allergens, labels, and scores (Nutri-Score, NOVA, Eco-Score). Data is crowd-sourced and available under an open license. No API key is required for standard read access.

auth.details: No authentication required for standard product read and search endpoints. Write operations (product contributions) require a free user account with User-Agent identification recommended for all requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free and open; no paid plans. Rate limiting applies (see rate_limits).

rate_limits: 15 req/min/IP for product reads (GET /api/v*/product); 10 req/min/IP for search (GET /api/v*/search or /cgi/search.pl). Custom User-Agent required. Global abuse limits may return HTTP 503. Bulk use: download CSV/JSONL exports or host a local instance.
use_cases: look up a food product by barcode for ingredients and nutrition
search products by name or brand
get Nutri-Score, NOVA, and allergen info for a product
build a shopping or diet app product catalog from open data
check labels and additives for a packaged food item
